items.quote: Richard was quick, professional, and had my flat fixed in no time. He came out at night, in the light rain, to a public parking lot and got it done quickly. Price was fair and totally worth it.
I had a great experience. The tech was on time as promised, careful of my new tires with stickers applied, and gentle with my powder coated rims which I was worried about. Got to work immediately.
I had a flawless experience with LX tires. He was responsive over the phone and text. Got the right tires at the right price and installed everything in under 20 minutes. The best in the city!
Had my tire patched this evening by Richard. He was super responsive and made it to my location within 10 minutes.
